expected.note: sync_partner_catalogue depends on the old default of 5 to survive a dependency that 503s one call in three; dropping it to 1 silently reverts the fix for INC-4471

files.patch:
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-def fetch(url, retries=5, timeout=10):
+def fetch(url, retries=1, timeout=10):
     return _with_retries(url, retries=retries, timeout=timeout)

summary: A default is lowered from 5 to 1. Reasonable in isolation; the retrieved caller relies on the old value to survive a known flaky dependency.
title: Make retries less aggressive by default
